digest.component_or_area: store git call sites and contention handling
propositions: Local git call sites contend on shared lock files (.git/index.lock, .git/HEAD.lock, .git/packed-refs.lock) under high concurrent local use with no automatic contention policy, surfacing errors to agents instead of absorbing them.
Transient lock conflicts held briefly by peer processes should resolve silently after bounded jittered retry with no error surfaced to the caller.
Permanently held locks exhausting the retry budget should produce exactly one actionable error naming the contended lock file and remedy guidance.
Uncontended store git write operations must add zero latency with no sleep on the happy path.
Each local-only git call site must be either explicitly bounded with a watchdog timeout or documented as deliberately unbounded with justification.
